name: flyto-i18n
description: Fix a translation once and share it across every Flyto2 product, docs, and website surface.

scripts.lint: python3 -m compileall -q scripts tests translate_th.py && ruff check scripts tests translate_th.py && npm run docs:check
scripts.test: python3 scripts/validate.py --strict && python3 scripts/coverage.py --json >/tmp/flyto-i18n-coverage.json && python3 -m pytest -q
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
